text:
tess: Random question: who is leaving the tiny garden gnome by the milk in the fridge?
omar: Guilty. He needed a cool down. Also he likes lactose.
yuki: The gnome has claimed my yogurt. He left a tiny note that says 'on weekend duty'.
chris: Please tell me the gnome pays rent. I have a missing sock and suspect gnome rental income.
tess: Vote: evict gnome or give him a name and responsibilities? Reply with 1 for evict, 2 for name
omar: 2. Name suggestion: Sir Fridge-a-lot
yuki: 2. If he tends the milk, he gets a name and a tiny hat.
office-bot: Reminder: shared food policy requires labeling and dates. Placing items in the fridge implies consent to community gnome inspection. (automatic)
chris: I will volunteer to make a tiny hat if Sir Fridge-a-lot is adopted. Also I want my sock back.
tess: Plan: adopt and name Sir Fridge-a-lot, create hat at craft hour, label community food with dates. If gnome is found near someone's lunch without label, he will be politely escorted.
omar: He promises to be a polite gnome and will not touch salad.
yuki: GIF: link_to_gnome-waving.gif caption: "New fridge supervisor"
chris: Outcome: gnome adopted, craft hat scheduled, sock investigation ongoing. Thread closed unless the gnome moves to the pantry.
